name: Chrony
description: Chrony is an NTP implementation that runs here as a time server for your network, at stratum 1, 2 or 3. Stratum 1 uses a GPS receiver through gpsd as its reference clock (NMEA and, where available, PPS); stratum 2 syncs from public stratum 1 servers and stratum 3 from the NTP pool or your own stratum 2 server.

notes.text: Stratum 1 needs a USB GPS receiver on the Proxmox host before the container is created; it runs privileged so /dev/ttyACM0-1 and /dev/ttyUSB0-1 are passed through. Stratum 2 and 3 run unprivileged.
Stratum 1 needs a GPS fix: wait until 'chronyc sources' marks NMEA or PPS with '*', and tune the NMEA offset in /etc/chrony/conf.d/server.conf if it is rejected.
Stratum 2 syncs from TimeNL, PTB and NIST, stratum 3 from pool.ntp.org; set var_ntp_servers to use your own upstream servers.
